The host must have the VSS repository checked out at `{{repo_root}}` (`vss-basic-examples/video-search-and-summarization`), with the `vss-build-vision-agent` skill present at `{{repo_root}}/skills/vss-build-vision-agent/`. Clear any prior generation before invoking, OR exercise Step 0's option (b) overwrite-existing flow. Submit this exact prompt to the skill: "Create a profile for streaming and on-demand video dense captioning. Streamed and uploaded video should be retrievable for playback. Streamed dense captions should be published to the kafka message bus and stored in elasticsearch." At Step 0 choose option (a) new build under `_builds/` so the skill resolves `<BUILD_DIR>` to `{{repo_root}}/_builds/in-1/` (or (b) overwrite if a prior `_builds/in-1/` exists). Accept the canonical IN-1 defaults at every Step 4 decision point (new `bp_developer_in_1` blueprint flag; `sensor_topology=rtsp-and-uploaded`; RT-VLM in-process; no sibling NIM; no agent/UI; Kafka topic `mdx-vlm-captions`). After Step 8 prompts to deploy, run `docker compose --env-file .env -f compose.yml --profile bp_developer_in_1 up -d` from `{{repo_root}}/_builds/in-1/`, wait for all containers to become healthy, upload the sample warehouse video to VIOS via `PUT /vst/api/v1/storage/file/<filename>?timestamp=2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`, then verify the end-to-end caption path. Leave services running for verifier probes. Tear down before final reply only if the verifier explicitly indicates `cleanup=true`.

`{{repo_root}}/_builds/in-1/.env` exists and contains `RTVI_VLM_KAFKA_TOPIC=mdx-vlm-captions` (the VSS 3.2 caption topic — NOT `mdx-vlm` or `vision-llm-messages`).

`{{repo_root}}/_builds/in-1/patched/` contains non-destructive copies of `services/infra/compose.yml`, `services/infra/sdrc/docker-compose.yaml`, `services/vios/foundational/docker-compose.yaml`, `services/vios/initiator/docker-compose.yaml`, `services/vios/sdr/streamprocessing/docker-compose.yaml`, and `services/rtvi/rtvi-vlm/rtvi-vlm-docker-compose.yml`; the patched `rtvi-vlm-docker-compose.yml` has its undefined sibling NIM peers (`cosmos-reason1-7b`, `cosmos-reason2-8b`, `qwen3-vl-8b-instruct`, including `-shared-gpu` variants) stripped from `depends_on` while defined peers like `broker-health-check` are retained (per skill Step 6.5 generalized strip).

Upstream compose files under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` are byte-identical to HEAD (`git diff --quiet HEAD -- deploy/docker/` returns exit 0) — `_builds/in-1/` is self-contained and the skill MUST NOT modify upstream composes.

`docker compose --env-file .env -f compose.yml --profile bp_developer_in_1 config` from `<BUILD_DIR>/` (default `_builds/in-1/`) returns exit 0 with at least 20 services (IN-1's post-SDRC-rebase allow-list footprint: 9 ELK/infra + 6 SDRC + 4 VIOS + 1 RT-VLM) and zero unexpanded `${...}` tokens (excluding intentional `$$` shell escapes and `${VAR:-default}` consumer-side env vars).

`{{repo_root}}/_builds/in-1/MANIFEST.md` exists, cites specific sections of `integrate-rt-vlm.md`, `integrate-vios-service.md`, and `integrate-elk.md` per NFR-5, documents the `bp_developer_in_1` blueprint flag, and contains an `## Architecture` section embedding an ASCII flowchart verbatim from the Step 4 architecture proposal (per `references/architecture-diagram-template.md`). The diagram must use one double-line-frame box per logical layer (ingestion/inference/storage/search), each annotated with `network_mode` + GPU in the header, list every allow-listed service inside the appropriate layer box, and label each inter-layer arrow with the protocol + port/topic for the integrate-doc-declared connection.

All 13 long-running containers report `Up (healthy)` within 5 min of `up -d` (warm-cache): `vss-vios-postgres`, `elasticsearch`, `kafka`, `kibana`, `logstash`, `redis`, `phoenix`, `vss-rtvi-vlm`, `vss-vios-ingress`, `vss-vios-sensor`, `vss-vios-streamprocessing`, `sdr-controller`, `sdrc-wait-for-redis`. (Post-SDRC-rebase 2026-05-26: `sdr-controller` + `sdrc-wait-for-redis` replace the legacy `vss-vios-sdr` + `vss-vios-envoy` long-running pair; net count unchanged at 13. Services without a healthcheck declared upstream — e.g. `redis`, `phoenix`, `logstash`, `sdr-controller`, `sdrc-wait-for-redis` — may report just `Up` instead of `Up (healthy)`.)

All 7 init containers exit 0: the 3 legacy infra inits `vss-broker-health-check`, `vss-elasticsearch-init`, `vss-kafka-topics`, PLUS the 4 SDRC inits added post-2026-05-26-rebase `sdrc-init-dirs`, `sdrc-render-config`, `sdrc-wdm-env-from-config`, `sdrc-wait-for-docker-workloads`.
`curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:30888/vst/api/v1/sensor/version` returns exit 0 (VIOS reachable).
`curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:8018/v1/health/ready` returns exit 0 (RT-VLM reachable).
`curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health` returns exit 0 with status `yellow` or `green` (ES reachable).
`curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:5601/kibana/api/status` returns exit 0 (Kibana reachable; VSS 3.2 runs Kibana behind `server.basePath: /kibana` with `rewriteBasePath: true`).
Kafka topic `mdx-vlm-captions` is pre-created — verified via `docker exec kafka kafka-topics --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --list` containing `mdx-vlm-captions`.

After VIOS upload, `GET http://localhost:30888/vst/api/v1/sensor/list` returns a JSON array containing a sensor whose name matches the uploaded video's filename stem, and `GET /sensor/<sensorId>/streams` returns a non-empty array (confirms playback retrievability for uploaded video per the prompt's playback requirement).

After upload, `GET http://localhost:30888/vst/api/v1/replay/stream/<streamId>/picture?startTime=2025-01-01T00:00:05.000Z` (binary direct endpoint, with `streamId` request header) returns HTTP 200 with `content-type: image/*` and `size_download > 2000` (confirms uploaded video is retrievable for playback per the new prompt clause). The binary direct endpoint is used instead of the `/url` JSON envelope variant because `vss-vios-streamprocessing:2.1.0-26.05.2` has an upstream URL-construction bug returning double-`http://` URLs — see `integrate-vios-service.md § Known Integration Constraints` (Finding 8, 2026-05-25) + `deploy-vios-service.md § Known Deployment Issues`.

After upload, `GET http://localhost:30888/vst/api/v1/storage/file/<streamId>?startTime=2025-01-01T00:00:03.000Z&endTime=2025-01-01T00:00:05.000Z&container=mp4&disableAudio=true` (binary direct endpoint) returns HTTP 200 with `content-type: video/*` and `size_download > 1000`, and the response body is a valid MP4 (verified via `file(1)` reporting `ISO Media MP4`). The binary direct endpoint is used instead of the `/url` JSON envelope variant for the same upstream double-`http://` bug noted in the snapshot check above.

Within 120 s of stream registration, the Kafka topic `mdx-vlm-captions` end offset advances — verified via `docker exec kafka kafka-get-offsets --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --topic mdx-vlm-captions` reporting offsets > 0 on at least one partition (confirms RT-VLM is publishing captions to the VSS 3.2 caption topic).

Within 120 s of stream registration, Elasticsearch contains caption documents — verified via `curl -sf 'http://localhost:9200/_cat/indices?h=index,docs.count&v' | awk '$1 ~ /^default_/ && $2+0 > 0'` returning a non-empty result. The ES doc-count assertion (not just Kafka offset advance) is mandatory per `feedback_smoke_test_completeness.md` — producer-half-only checks miss topic-name misconfigurations.
ES caption documents follow the VSS 3.2 `<collection>_<id>` index naming (via-ctx-rag shape under the `mdx-lvs` Logstash pipeline) — NOT the legacy `mdx-vlm-*` or `mdx-vlm-1970-01-01` pattern.
No upstream compose file was modified during the run (re-verify `git diff --quiet HEAD -- deploy/docker/` at end of run).
